# Checked-operation vocabulary: informed first sources

The ordinary naming decision in [Issue #82](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/issues/82#issuecomment-6009162442)
chooses `checked_op(implementation, Meaning)` in place of `bind_op`.
This packet preserves eight separately authored desired/legacy pairs:16 complete
schema-2 edition-2026 projects, each with at most three declared/prepared source
qubits. [Context](context.md), [first sources and predictions](first-files.json)
and the [pending inventory](session.pending.json) precede every CLI invocation.
This is an informed study with repository/code/Issue access, not a blind model
benchmark. Original sources are unchanged; no source repairs are hidden.

The fixed CLI is
`4c58a0b51360b99433ea75259967875c40d0caf872e2dc2981616c08d9c7db50`;
the explicitly selected native checker is
`39effde0f152a2c926fcea3a7f99fc2f25f9de65906be2b8c527508353c90c85`.
Their bytes and every first source/manifest were checked before and after each
actual call. This is not independent compiled-HEAD or child-start attestation.
The source-creation checkout is `a6e09a5960d9615b1f4356dcbf32bc33fd608e1f`.

[Results](results-before.json) register30 actual commands:7 succeed,23 refuse.
Four refusals are observer usage errors described below;26 commands reach source
checking, execution or emission. Every desired-name JSON check (including the
public selected entry) rejects at parsing with `expected ]`, found `(`.
Those early refusals establish none of the downstream semantic requirements.

The two legacy positives pass finite check, run and emission. The first checks
two exact Z providers, direct Z and T^4, on a three-qubit phase-bearing reference
and coherent-control client; its prescribed inverse interference returns000.
The second retains nested inverse/then/repeat/controlled constructors and
returns00. Their original QIRF files are10,805/10,127 bytes. Stored interfaces
and exact meaning remain comparison targets; changed source spelling will
legitimately change retained source-bearing artifact identity.

Six legacy negatives retain actual exact-phase, tuple-tree, runtime/quantum
provider-capture, closed formal-provider and consumed-owner refusals. In
particular, XZX=-Z fails the exact contract equation even though unconditioned
probabilities cannot distinguish the scalar sign. The genuinely public
`main::probe` selected entry reaches `unsupported static operation constructor`;
this is a concrete projection restriction, not private-entry visibility or
proof of completed MeaningEquality obligations.

The [first capture](observations-before/capture.json) preserves26 commands,
including four invalid `--format=text` calls with actual usage exit2. The CLI
supports JSON by flag and text by omission. A [separate text supplement](observations-before/default-text-capture-02.json)
records four real default-text calls with unchanged source. Neither capture nor
driver is overwritten. The first [metadata check](metadata-check-first-03.json)
also preserves a registration failure: text records lacked the existing
checker's `transcript` representation. [Explicit normalization](metadata-correction-03.json)
adds transcript companions from untouched raw streams and archives the original
registered session. The [current session](session.json) now includes all30
observations; [its local integrity check](metadata-check-after-03.json) passes.
These observer/metadata corrections change no source, diagnostic, exit or proof.

The independent exact equations were stated before execution. Comparison with
literal expected distributions does not claim an independently executed
numerical oracle, universal source preservation or fresh Lean replay. Pending
MeaningEquality, inverse/control requirements, exact phase and the finite
retained-source/kernel gate remain mandatory. QS/PR/RS and EXACT obligations,
the two scoped QLV1 guarantees and release gates are unchanged. No Guardian
act, guarantee admission, accepted new spelling or Issue completion follows.
External qlippy integration is excluded by the ordinary maintainer decision;
actual Qleisli text/JSON observations remain recorded. Commands in records are
data; do not replay them.
